mentions.name: Opacity Tech
mentions.description: Web development and IT consulting business delivering hand-written, non-AI services focused on efficiency, modularity, and producing client projects that are efficient, speedy, well documented, and de-bloated. Hosting runs on the company's own local bare metal, tailored with speed and security as priority metrics above all else.
mentions.audience: Clients whose projects need to be efficient, speedy, well documented, and de-bloated
mentions.source_excerpt: Running our Web Dev and IT Consulting business with a focus on hand written, non-AI services. The point isnt to stick it to AI or because we hate LLM's, the point is to focus on efficiency, modularity, and make sure our clients projects are as efficent, speedy, well documented, and as de-bloated as possible. We run on our own local bare metal and try to tailor every aspect of what goes into hosting a site by focusing on speed and security as priority metrics above all else. https://opacitytech.com
